text: Lior Beres Hi Lior, thanks for sharing! I actually came across this article before (and we will also go to Tel Aviv to obtain an OEC), but it covers different documentation. The CFO Counseling Certificate is a separate requirement. The Philippine immigration asks for it when a spouse visa is on the passport, but it seems inconsistent. Sometimes they ask for it, sometimes they don't, but it is supposed to be standard protocol. I was going through my checklist before heading back to the Philippines and ran into this hurdle. It's a mandatory counseling program for Filipinos relocating abroad as a spouse, originally set up to help protect against mail-order bride situations. I wasn't asked for it the last time because I was still on a B-2 visa.
